Of the under-15s Natalie Law really looks the business when she sprints but on this day she could only pick up two 2nd places while that determined 1500m runner Abigail Gray also ran to 2nd - but then she was up against an English Schools cross country champion.
This time there was no stopping Natalie Law as she romped to a double sprint win and Cindy James looked set for good points in the hurdles until she badly crashed at the last flight of barriers.

Natalie Law only signed up with the Bels in the Spring but she is already making a name for herself. A product of our Crystal Palace Wednesday night initiative she is regularly chipping away at her pbs and here did so again to win the Junior 200m.

Early on, Natalie Law set a sparkling new Under-15 200m Club Record of 25.34 to get up to 3rd place and progress to the finals.
